families.limits: Lexing/layout/recovery owned by sibling audit. Tokens/trivia are non-executable retained syntax; Decimal expression emission separately unsupported. Numeric bounds/string escapes require validation beyond recognition. No source interpolation grammar.
Composition/import closure and implicit owner facts flow into app/package definitions. Clean emission does not deploy or invoke app.
Resource/settings syntax checked; modules carry bindings/locale. Deployment references are not independently authored resources; resource provisioning is external.

read_import collects provider/member alias/from into Module.imports. resolve_imports iterates imports; resolve_import admits local or bound external namespaces and bind_import_alias/bind_import_fixture populate production/test scopes. IR build_modules preserves imports as IrImport and resolve_member consumes aliases. No independent import statement execution meaning; signatures/exports and binding/catalog availability remain separate checks.

Named/union/array/nullable/enum/action/delivery/invocation types checked; runtime type-id projection is partial: action/invocation/object/opaque/unknown reject at JS type_id. Carrier admissibility varies by field/parameter/result use.
Defaults/modifiers/server initializers have separate checking and emission. Signature defaults are checked left-to-right; source trace is not full ordering execution proof.

Attached prose/reference, inline desc and legacy desc annotation converge to metadata, never source interpolation. Duplicates/static zero-parameter/locale/caption conditions are checking work. Docs is an actual non-execution consumer.

ICU parameter substitution is validated by examples pattern parser and emitted message descriptors. JSON source strings are not general interpolated strings; format/message calls use ordinary call syntax.
Paths/selectors/attributes are contextual carriers consumed by owning declarations, never independently emitted. Query order and UI order have distinct admissibility.

Call SyntaxKind is shared with statement call. Parsed/checkable expressions may lower to Unsupported/E6008. Decimal literal specifically emits throwing placeholder and E6008; catalog planned builtin E6001 and emission availability are separate admission. No source string interpolation.

Stored model query and value array query differ: value where/select require synchronous callbacks; value order/archived unsupported. Expression query ordering lacks lowering; simple stored selector ordering supported. Rust parse_expr_inner and normative query_tail admit only archived/as/where/order/select, not a limit clause. The IR limit branch is not source admission evidence; execution for loops and builtin named limit use separate forms.
Section/category/exports are structural ownership. Not every admitted Given form dispatches into semantic tables; Corpus/Judgment tracked separately.
Schemas/ownership/roles and preferences feed runtime metadata plus grants; full stored lifecycle behavior is external to parsing/emission.
Field/function distinction is syntactic; dependencies/types/effects checked. Structured derived labels accepted by current Rust parser unlike unchanged prototype boundary prose.

Policies/invariants/unique/locks/retention published as runtime rules/metadata; emitted policy reports do not themselves enforce permissions. Retain nullable datetime semantics needs runtime qualification.
Record/file/user/operation-delivery recipe fixtures are test-only producers. Generated closures consumed by testkit; seeding/provisioning and actual execution separate.
Source signatures and binding/catalog availability flow into metadata and call-target lowering; deployment-bound opaque signatures remain gaps, not verified provider execution.

Parser accepts closed required attributes; resolver index_given, type phase2 and effects dispatch omit Corpus, so no corpus semantic/runtime declaration is produced. Absence anchors are entire dispatch regions. Treat accepted declaration as unimplemented semantic gap.

Resolver indexes judgment as fieldless Contract and marks it in judgments; paths/types/values poison judgment bindings (Binding::Error). Type/effect declaration passes omit derived judgment interface. A fieldless contract-shaped emitted placeholder must not be called judgment execution.

User/trusted/CRUD variants and periodic/each source cohorts have specific semantic admission. Root-bound recurring scopes unsupported. expose/refresh/import additions are present Rust parser; prototype remains older. each=<path> [as NAME] is recovered into Attribute syntax by parse_each_attribute while emitting E1203; it is a proposed unsupported syntax form, not clean accepted fan-out.

Bindings execute inside do; guards/if/for/effects retain order in statement IR. Create/set/delete hooks and send/schedule/cancel/call/return have runtime owner calls; partial effect shapes can still produce Unsupported. Full permission/rollback/order execution not tested by this map.
Input-selector/seed/caller/request/receipt rules checked separately from parse shape; emitted suite is executable test input, not proof rows ran. Root workflow FORWARD_TEST currently executed:0.
Rust parser/checker/IR/BDD support explicit sequences. GRAMMAR prototype sentence refers to tools/can_parser.py, not Rust compiler; no full sequence behavior claimed.

Core groups/forms/collections/routes emit supported factories. Preferences panel falls through to unknown factory and E6008. Generic CatalogItem admission permits arbitrary word/options; declared 68-component contract not fully enforced. Board/calendar/gallery factories also absent JS whitelist. Factory availability does not prove DOM/renderer behavior. Tab nodes hit decode_ui fallback, which retains factory word but emits empty props/children; caption/descendants can be lost even though tab is an admitted JS factory. Qualify with focused probe.

Rust parses preference-order records; decode_collection treats order like ordinary selector_strings. selector_strings handles only Selectors/Descending/Path and returns [] for PreferenceOrder, so structured by/default/cases order becomes an empty emitted selector array. No dedicated preference-order type/IR contract found. Focused public probe remains necessary; no supported preference-driven runtime behavior claim.
Parser enforces contiguous route shape; model/scalar suitability and collisions are semantic. Published page routing descriptors need actual router acceptance qualification.

Structural migration admission happens in IR build via check_migration. Backfill restricted parse body and checked metadata are not installed snapshot matching, application/queued work compatibility, or execution proof. No dedicated migration executor in compiler.
families.consumer_join: Separate runtime migration APIs exist; no complete compiler directive-to-installed execution join established here.

grammar_inventory.name: app_implicit
grammar_inventory.text: app_implicit    = line("app" NAME app_attributes) [context] {line(import {";" import})} sections ;

grammar_inventory.name: context_declaration
grammar_inventory.text: context_declaration = "theme" attributes | "files" attributes | "locale" attributes | "binding" NAME "DurableObject" attributes | "queue" NAME attributes | "cache" "KV" attributes | "analytics" NAME schema ;

grammar_inventory.name: app_attributes
grammar_inventory.text: app_attributes  = attributes with uses present for app_composed and absent for app_implicit ;

grammar_inventory.name: type_base
grammar_inventory.text: type_base        = path {"|" path} | enum_type | action_type | delivery_type | invocation_type ;

grammar_inventory.name: primary
grammar_inventory.text: primary        = INTEGER | DECIMAL | DURATION | BYTES | STRING [message_variants] | "true" | "false" | "null" | VALUE_NAME | "(" expr ")" | array | values | typed_value ;

grammar_inventory.name: call_expr
grammar_inventory.text: call_expr      = postfix with a final arguments suffix ;

grammar_inventory.name: given_leaf
grammar_inventory.text: given_leaf     = corpus | preferences | ["export"] (model | contract | event | role | pure_function | fixture | message) | ordinary_given ;

grammar_inventory.name: ordinary_given
grammar_inventory.text: ordinary_given = derive_field | policy | invariant | unique | lock | retain ;

grammar_inventory.name: judgment_leaf
grammar_inventory.text: judgment_leaf  = NAME "noul" caption ["yes" "=" caption "no" "=" caption] | NAME "choice" caption (judgment_choices | "options" "=" "runtime" [judgment_choices]) | NAME "score" caption "[" separated(judgment_option) [","] "]" ;

grammar_inventory.name: when_items
grammar_inventory.text: when_items      = {line(crud_head {";" crud_head}) | crud_head suite(crud_examples) | user_scenario | trusted_scenario} ;

grammar_inventory.name: effect_leaf
grammar_inventory.text: effect_leaf     = let | guard | create | set | delete | call | emit | send | schedule | cancel | return ;

grammar_inventory.name: expected_error
grammar_inventory.text: expected_error    = call_expr with bare callee "error" and exactly one argument ;

grammar_inventory.name: example_call
grammar_inventory.text: example_call      = "call" ordinary values "by" "=" example_caller ["request" "=" values] ["as" NAME] ["->" expected_error] ;

grammar_inventory.name: core_ui_item
grammar_inventory.text: core_ui_item   = line(ui_leaves) | ui_group | collection | form | tabs_group ;

grammar_inventory.name: ui_leaf
grammar_inventory.text: ui_leaf        = "require" expr | "title" expr | "text" observations | "content" observations | "metrics" observations | "copy" expr | "edit" attributes | "delete" | "action" expr | "actions" separated(expr) | "history" | collection_header | form_header | "tabs" expr ;

grammar_inventory.name: ui_group
grammar_inventory.text: ui_group       = "card" expr attributes suite(ui_body) | "details" expr attributes suite(ui_body) ;
